about.p2: Sonexa Game Studios is small and independent. The code, the art, the music and the sound all come from the same desk, so every detail gets the same care from beginning to end — and a game only ships once it feels right in your hands.
about.title: Made entirely in-house

contact.sub: The studio is small enough that your message reaches the person who made the thing. Bug reports especially — send them.
contact.title: Bugs, questions, high scores

footer.note: An independent game studio. More on the way.
footer.rights: © 2026 Sonexa Game Studios. All rights reserved.

drumhit.desc: Built by a drummer who wanted to play along properly, not tap along. Hit every kick, snare, tom, crash and hi-hat yourself, jam freely in Free Mode, or import a song from your device and chart it note by note in the editor.
drumhit.tagline: The music plays. The drums are up to you.

games.sub: Different genres, same obsession — the half second where a game either feels right or it doesn't.
games.title: What we've made so far

tower.desc: Blocks slide across the screen and one tap drops them. Land it clean and your combo lives; miss and the block gets trimmed thinner. The climb runs from a back garden, past the clouds and the passing planes, out into the dark.
tower.tagline: Tap, stack, and build your tower all the way to space.

wobbins.desc: Play a chunky plush Wobbin that paints itself the exact colour of walls and furniture to vanish in plain sight. The seeker hunts in first person with a paint gun — and every hider they tag joins the hunt. Quick matches, private rooms, camouflaging bots, and a wardrobe full of hats.
wobbins.tagline: Hide-and-seek with a twist: paint yourself the colour of the wall.

hero.sub: An independent studio working in whatever genre the idea calls for — and finishing it properly.
hero.tagline: We make the games we want to play

meta.description: Independent game studio behind DrumHit, Wobbins: Hide & Hue and Tower To Space — rhythm, arcade and multiplayer games, out now on Google Play.
meta.ogDescription: Independent game studio. Rhythm, arcade and multiplayer games, with more on the way.
meta.title: Sonexa Game Studios — Independent Games
